#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independently inspect actual GitHub standalone archive bytes for one revision."""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
import math
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import tarfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

REPO = Path('/workspace/scratch/5ba97739b54c/Hammond-B3-Organ')
SDL = REPO.parent/'SDL2'


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def unique(pairs):
    value = {}
    for key, item in pairs:
        assert key not in value, key
        value[key] = item
    return value


def reject(value):
    raise ValueError(value)


def parse(data):
    return json.loads(data, object_pairs_hook=unique, parse_constant=reject)


def safe(name):
    path = PurePosixPath(name)
    assert name and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
    assert not any(c in name for c in ('\\', ':', '\x00'))
    return path


def zip_data(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        members = archive.infolist()
        assert len(members) <= 100
        assert sum(m.file_size for m in members) < 25_000_000
        assert len({str(safe(m.filename)) for m in members}) == len(members)
        result = {}
        for member in members:
            assert not member.flag_bits & 1
            mode = member.external_attr >> 16
            assert not stat.S_ISLNK(mode) and not mode & 0o7000
            assert not stat.S_IFMT(mode) or stat.S_ISREG(mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(mode)
            result[member.filename] = archive.read(member)
        return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('root', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    metadata = parse((root/'downloads.json').read_bytes())
    commit, tree, run = (metadata[k] for k in ('source_commit','source_tree','run_id'))
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',commit+'^{tree}'],cwd=REPO).decode().strip() == tree

    def source(path):
        return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{commit}:{path}'],cwd=REPO)

    artifacts = {x['id']:x for x in metadata['artifacts']}
    for item in metadata['downloads']:
        raw = (root/item['file']).read_bytes()
        row = artifacts[item['id']]
        assert len(raw) == item['bytes'] == row['size_in_bytes']
        assert digest(raw) == item['sha256'] == row['digest'].split(':')[1]
        assert row['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == commit
        assert str(row['workflow_run']['id']) == run and not row['expired']
    assert len(metadata['downloads']) == 6
    sources = {
        'LICENSE-DejaVu.txt':'assets/standalone/fonts/LICENSE-DejaVu.txt',
        'STANDALONE_APP.md':'docs/STANDALONE_APP.md',
        'STANDALONE_INSTALL.md':'docs/STANDALONE_INSTALL.md',
        'STANDALONE_MODEL.md':'docs/STANDALONE_MODEL.md',
        'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md':'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md',
        'font-source-manifest.json':'assets/standalone/fonts/source-manifest.json',
        'sdl2-lock.json':'data/dependencies/sdl2-lock.json',
    }
    expected_tests = {'test_standalone_'+name for name in (
        'session','ui','state_files','concurrency','audio_device','callback_allocation',
        'app','install','benchmark','workflows','replay_boundaries','chapel',
        'input_replay','device_removal')}
    summary = {'source_commit':commit,'source_tree':tree,'run_id':run,
               'downloads':metadata['downloads'],'platforms':{}}
    for platform in ('linux','windows','macos'):
        package = zip_data(root/f'{platform}-package.zip')
        diag = zip_data(root/f'{platform}-diagnostics.zip')
        assert set(package) == {'HammondB3-Standalone-Release.tar.gz','inventory.json','SHA256SUMS'}
        sums = {}
        for line in package['SHA256SUMS'].decode().splitlines():
            expected, name = line.split(maxsplit=1)
            name = name.lstrip('*')
            assert name in package and name not in sums and digest(package[name]) == expected
            sums[name] = expected
        assert set(sums) == {'HammondB3-Standalone-Release.tar.gz','inventory.json'}
        inv = parse(package['inventory.json'])
        provenance = inv['provenance']
        assert provenance['source_commit'] == commit and provenance['source_tree'] == tree
        assert provenance['run_id'] == run and provenance['run_attempt'] == '1'
        assert inv['relocated_help_passed'] is True and inv['relocated_dummy_smoke_ms'] == 600
        assert package['inventory.json'] == diag['standalone-ci-logs/installed-inventory.json']
        assert inv['payload'] == parse(diag['standalone-ci-logs/staged-inventory.json'])
        assert provenance == parse(diag['standalone-ci-logs/provenance.json'])
        assert inv['smoke_diagnostics_sha256'] == digest(diag['standalone-ci-logs/relocated-smoke.json'])
        assert inv['screenshot_sha256'] == digest(diag['standalone-ci-logs/relocated-smoke.bmp'])
        assert diag['standalone-ci-logs/relocated-smoke.bmp'][:2] == b'BM'
        files = {x['path']:x for x in inv['payload']['files']}
        dirs = {x['path']:x for x in inv['payload']['directories']}
        assert len(files) == len(inv['payload']['files']) == 9
        assert len(dirs) == len(inv['payload']['directories']) == 5
        payload, seen_dirs, seen_paths = {},set(),set()
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(package['HammondB3-Standalone-Release.tar.gz']),mode='r:gz') as archive:
            members = archive.getmembers()
            assert len(members) == 14 and sum(x.size for x in members) < 10_000_000
            for member in members:
                path = safe(member.name)
                assert path.parts[0] == 'HammondB3-Standalone'
                rel = str(PurePosixPath(*path.parts[1:]))
                assert rel not in seen_paths
                seen_paths.add(rel)
                assert (member.isfile() or member.isdir()) and not member.mode & 0o7000
                assert set(member.pax_headers) <= {'mtime'}
                if 'mtime' in member.pax_headers:
                    assert math.isfinite(float(member.pax_headers['mtime']))
                if member.isdir():
                    assert rel in dirs and member.mode == int(dirs[rel]['mode'],8)
                    seen_dirs.add(rel)
                else:
                    assert rel in files
                    raw = archive.extractfile(member).read()
                    row = files[rel]
                    assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] == member.size
                    assert digest(raw) == row['sha256'] and member.mode == int(row['mode'],8)
                    payload[rel] = raw
        assert set(payload) == set(files) and seen_dirs == set(dirs)
        base = 'share/hammond-b3-organ/standalone/'
        for filename, path in sources.items():
            assert payload[base+filename] == source(path)
        lock = parse(source('data/dependencies/sdl2-lock.json'))
        def sdl_source(path):
            return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',lock['commit']+':'+path],cwd=SDL)
        license_sdl = sdl_source('LICENSE.txt')
        assert payload[base+'LICENSE-SDL2.txt'] == license_sdl
        assert digest(license_sdl) == lock['license']['sha256']
        notices = payload[base+'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md']
        secondary = {}
        for name in ('src/video/yuv2rgb/LICENSE','src/hidapi/LICENSE-bsd.txt'):
            raw = sdl_source(name)
            assert raw in notices, name
            secondary[name] = {'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':digest(raw),'full_bytes_present':True}
        math_source = sdl_source('src/libm/e_pow.c')
        copyright_at = math_source.index(b'Copyright (C) 1993 by Sun Microsystems')
        start = math_source.rfind(b'/*',0,copyright_at)
        end = math_source.index(b'*/',copyright_at)+2
        sun = math_source[start:end]
        assert sun in notices and b'configurations that include those routines' in notices
        secondary['Sun-math-notice'] = {'source_sha256':digest(math_source),
             'notice_bytes':len(sun),'notice_sha256':digest(sun),'full_notice_present':True,
             'scope':'conditional inclusion; no claim that every archive member is linked'}
        assert b'--config Release --target hammond_standalone' in payload[base+'STANDALONE_APP.md']
        assert b'--config Release --target hammond_standalone' in payload[base+'STANDALONE_INSTALL.md']
        assert b'apps/standalone/Release/' in payload[base+'STANDALONE_APP.md']
        assert set(provenance['dependencies']) == {'sdl2','fonts'}
        for dep in provenance['dependencies'].values():
            raw = source(dep['source_path'])
            assert digest(raw) == dep['sha256'] and parse(raw) == dep['identity']
        for font in provenance['dependencies']['fonts']['identity']['fonts']:
            raw = source('assets/standalone/fonts/'+font['file'])
            assert digest(raw) == font['sha256'] and len(raw) == font['bytes']
        backends = parse(diag['standalone-ci-logs/sdl-backends.json'])
        assert provenance['sdl_backends'] == backends
        config = diag['standalone-ci-logs/SDL_config-Release.h']
        assert digest(config) == backends['config_sha256']
        macros = {m[0].decode():m[1].strip().decode() for m in re.findall(
            rb'^#define\s+(SDL_(?:AUDIO|VIDEO)_DRIVER_\w+)\s+([^\r\n]+)',config,re.M)}
        assert macros == backends['compiled_macros']
        assert all(macros[key] == '1' for key in backends['required'])
        for language, filename in (('C','CMakeCCompiler.cmake'),('CXX','CMakeCXXCompiler.cmake')):
            compiler = diag['standalone-ci-logs/'+filename].decode()
            assert all(provenance['toolchain'][language][field] in compiler
                       for field in ('compiler_id','compiler_version'))
        smoke = parse(diag['standalone-ci-logs/relocated-smoke.json'])
        profile = parse(source('data/profiles/nominal-unmeasured-v1.json'))
        canonical = json.dumps(profile,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode()
        assert smoke['profile']['authoring_sha256'] == digest(canonical)
        assert smoke['runtime']['video_driver'] == 'dummy' and smoke['runtime']['renderer'] == 'software'
        assert smoke['runtime']['screenshot_written'] and smoke['runtime']['screenshot_while_held']
        audio, session = smoke['audio'],smoke['session']
        assert audio['driver'] == 'dummy' and audio['channels'] == 2
        assert audio['sample_rate'] == 48000 and audio['buffer_frames'] == 512
        assert audio['sample_format'] == audio['native_float32_format'] and audio['callback_count'] > 0
        assert audio['rendered_frames'] == audio['callback_count']*512 == session['frame_clock']
        assert all(audio[k] == 0 for k in ('render_failures','format_failures','overrange_failures',
                   'overrange_samples','nonfinite_failures','nonfinite_samples'))
        assert not session['running_after_shutdown'] and not session['held_after_shutdown']
        assert all(session[k] == 0 for k in ('fault_flags','queue_overflows','recovery_count','rejected_commands'))
        assert 0 < session['maximum_observed_peak'] <= 1 and smoke['errors'] == {'count':0,'last':''}
        assert all(smoke['smoke'][k] for k in ('requested','completed','note_on_sent','note_off_sent',
                                             'held_observed','release_observed','passed'))
        junit = ET.fromstring(diag['standalone-ci-logs/ctest.xml'])
        cases = list(junit.iter('testcase'))
        assert int(junit.attrib['tests']) == len(cases) == 14
        assert {case.attrib['name'] for case in cases} == expected_tests
        assert all(junit.attrib[k] == '0' for k in ('failures','disabled','skipped'))
        assert all(case.attrib['status'] == 'run' for case in cases)
        assert not list(junit.iter('failure')) and not list(junit.iter('error')) and not list(junit.iter('skipped'))
        binary = next(name for name in files if name.startswith('bin/'))
        log = diag['build-standalone/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log'].decode()
        assert f"Workflow executable SHA-256: {files[binary]['sha256']}" in log
        assert f"Native chapel main SHA-256: {digest(source('apps/standalone/main.cpp'))}" in log
        excluded = [line for line in log.splitlines() if 'NOT TESTED:' in line or " ... skipped '" in line]
        output = root/(platform+'-verified')
        assert not output.exists(), 'Do not overwrite an earlier actual extraction'
        output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        for name, raw in payload.items():
            path = output/'payload'/name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(raw)
            path.chmod(int(files[name]['mode'],8))
        for name, raw in diag.items():
            path = output/'diagnostics'/name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(raw)
        (output/'inventory.json').write_bytes(package['inventory.json'])
        summary['platforms'][platform] = {'files':list(files.values()),'directories':list(dirs.values()),
            'inner_sha256':sums,'executable':files[binary],'provenance':provenance,
            'junit':junit.attrib,'testcases':[case.attrib for case in cases],
            'internal_exclusions':excluded,'smoke':smoke,'secondary_notices':secondary,
            'diagnostic_files':[{ 'path':name,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':digest(raw)} for name,raw in diag.items()],
            'source_main_sha256':digest(source('apps/standalone/main.cpp'))}
        print(json.dumps({'platform':platform,'files':len(files),'suites':len(cases),
                          'executable_sha256':files[binary]['sha256'],'exclusions':excluded}),flush=True)
    (root/'artifact-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','platforms':3,'downloads':6,'source_commit':commit}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read actual executable headers/imports; this does not execute Windows/macOS."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import struct
import subprocess

MACHO_SOURCE = {
    'repository':'apple-oss-distributions/xnu',
    'commit':'f6217f891ac0bb64f3d375211650a4c1ff8ca1ea',
    'path':'EXTERNAL_HEADERS/mach-o/loader.h',
    'sha256':'8780a1e622375833b563f488bc820422c2fb5b8727bb8df8ceaa73ab6f0f88e3',
}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('root',type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    records, result = [], {'mach_o_layout_source':MACHO_SOURCE,'platforms':{}}
    for platform,filename in [('linux','hammond_standalone'),('windows','hammond_standalone.exe'),('macos','hammond_standalone')]:
        app = root/(platform+'-verified')/'payload/bin'/filename
        commands = [('file',['file',str(app)])]
        if platform == 'linux':
            commands += [('headers',['readelf','-h','-l','-d',str(app)]),
                         ('versions',['readelf','-V',str(app)]),('ldd',['ldd',str(app)])]
        if platform == 'windows':
            commands += [('imports',['objdump','-p',str(app)])]
        text = {}
        for label,argv in commands:
            log = root/f'{platform}-{label}.log'
            assert not log.exists(), log
            command = subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True)
            raw = command.stdout+command.stderr
            log.write_bytes(raw)
            assert command.returncode == 0,(platform,label)
            records.append({'platform':platform,'label':label,'argv':argv,
                'returncode':command.returncode,'log_bytes':len(raw),
                'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
            text[label] = raw.decode('utf-8')
        item = {'file':text['file'].strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(app.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        if platform == 'linux':
            floors = {}
            for prefix in ('GLIBC','GLIBCXX','CXXABI','GCC'):
                values = set(re.findall(r'Name: '+prefix+r'_(\d+(?:\.\d+)+)',text['versions']))
                floors[prefix] = max(values,key=lambda s:tuple(map(int,s.split('.'))))
            item.update(symbol_version_maxima=floors,
                needed=re.findall(r'\(NEEDED\).*\[([^]]+)\]',text['headers']),
                rpath_or_runpath=[line for line in text['headers'].splitlines() if 'RPATH' in line or 'RUNPATH' in line],
                local_dynamic_resolution=text['ldd'].splitlines())
            assert 'not found' not in text['ldd']
        elif platform == 'windows':
            item['dll_imports'] = re.findall(r'DLL Name:\s*(\S+)',text['imports'])
            item['certificate_directory'] = next(line.strip() for line in text['imports'].splitlines() if 'Security Directory' in line)
        else:
            raw = app.read_bytes()
            magic,cpu,subtype,filetype,ncmds,sizeofcmds,flags,reserved = struct.unpack_from('<IiiIIIII',raw)
            assert magic == 0xfeedfacf and cpu == 0x100000c and filetype == 2
            cursor,end = 32,32+sizeofcmds
            dylibs,versions,rpaths,signatures = [],[],[],[]
            version = lambda value:f'{value>>16}.{(value>>8)&255}.{value&255}'
            for unused in range(ncmds):
                cmd,size = struct.unpack_from('<II',raw,cursor)
                assert size >= 8 and size%8 == 0 and cursor+size <= end
                part = raw[cursor:cursor+size]
                if cmd in (0xc,0x80000018,0x8000001f):
                    offset,stamp,current,compat = struct.unpack_from('<IIII',part,8)
                    assert 24 <= offset < size
                    name = part[offset:part.index(b'\0',offset)].decode('utf-8')
                    dylibs.append({'command':hex(cmd),'name':name,'current':version(current),'compatibility':version(compat)})
                elif cmd == 0x32:
                    selected,minos,sdk,ntools = struct.unpack_from('<IIII',part,8)
                    assert size == 24+ntools*8
                    versions.append({'command':'LC_BUILD_VERSION','platform':selected,'minimum_os':version(minos),'sdk':version(sdk)})
                elif cmd == 0x24:
                    minos,sdk = struct.unpack_from('<II',part,8)
                    versions.append({'command':'LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX','minimum_os':version(minos),'sdk':version(sdk)})
                elif cmd == 0x8000001c:
                    offset = struct.unpack_from('<I',part,8)[0]
                    assert 12 <= offset < size
                    rpaths.append(part[offset:part.index(b'\0',offset)].decode())
                elif cmd == 0x1d:
                    offset,length = struct.unpack_from('<II',part,8)
                    assert offset+length <= len(raw)
                    signatures.append({'offset':offset,'bytes':length,
                        'scope':'load command exists; signing identity/notarization not verified'})
                cursor += size
            assert cursor == end
            item.update(architecture='arm64',load_commands=ncmds,versions=versions,
                        dylibs=dylibs,rpaths=rpaths,code_signature_commands=signatures)
        result['platforms'][platform] = item
    result['commands'] = records
    (root/'runtime-inspection.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','platforms':list(result['platforms']),
                      'linux_version_maxima':result['platforms']['linux']['symbol_version_maxima'],
                      'macos_versions':result['platforms']['macos']['versions']}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one exact downloaded Linux package, once, after private relocation."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import time

REPO = Path('/workspace/scratch/5ba97739b54c/Hammond-B3-Organ')
STATE = b'\tB3CONTROLS3\r\nexpression +3.75e-1\r\n' + b'''percussion enabled 1 harmonic third volume soft decay fast
pedal drawbars 2 7
manual upper selected A route_enabled 0
bank A 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8
bank B 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0
manual lower selected B route_enabled 1
bank A 1 3 5 7 0 2 4 6 8
bank B 8 6 4 2 0 7 5 3 1
end
 \t
'''.replace(b'\n',b'\r\n')
CONTROLS = {'manual_drawbars':[[[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8],[8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0]],
    [[1,3,5,7,0,2,4,6,8],[8,6,4,2,0,7,5,3,1]]], 'selected_banks':[0,1],
    'route_enabled':[False,True], 'expression':0.375,'pedal_drawbars':[2,7],
    'percussion':{'enabled':True,'harmonic':1,'volume':1,'decay':1}}
PREFIXES = [(0,((),(),())),(200,((60,),(),())),(650,((60,),(74,),())),
    (1100,((60,),(74,),(17,))),(1500,((),(74,),(17,))),(1700,((),(),(17,))),
    (1900,((),(),())),(2100,((72,),(),())),(2300,((),(),()))]


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('root',type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    verified = json.loads((root/'artifact-verification.json').read_text())
    commit = verified['source_commit']
    original = root/'linux-verified/payload'
    moved = root/'relocated Linux é 音'
    assert original.is_dir() and not moved.exists()
    original.rename(moved)
    assert not original.exists()
    rows = verified['platforms']['linux']['files']
    def check_payload():
        actual = {str(p.relative_to(moved)) for p in moved.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        assert actual == {r['path'] for r in rows}
        for row in rows:
            p = moved/row['path']
            assert not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size == row['bytes']
            assert digest(p.read_bytes()) == row['sha256']
            assert p.stat().st_mode & 0o7777 == int(row['mode'],8)
    check_payload()
    app = moved/'bin/hammond_standalone'
    work = root/'independent replay é 音'
    work.mkdir()
    state = work/'explicit-controls.b3controls'
    script = work/'keyboard-notes.b3ui'
    diagnostics = work/'keyboard-notes.json'
    state.write_bytes(STATE)
    script_bytes = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':examples/standalone-input/keyboard-notes.b3ui'],cwd=REPO)
    script.write_bytes(script_bytes)
    lines = script_bytes.decode('ascii').splitlines()
    assert lines[0:2] == ['B3UIREPLAY1','duration_ms 2600']
    assert len([line for line in lines[2:] if line and not line.startswith('#')]) == 18
    env = {'PATH':'','LANG':'C.UTF-8','LC_ALL':'C.UTF-8',
           'SDL_AUDIODRIVER':'dummy','SDL_VIDEODRIVER':'dummy','SDL_RENDER_DRIVER':'software'}
    commands = []
    def run(label,argv):
        started = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        before = time.monotonic()
        process = subprocess.run(list(map(str,argv)),cwd=work,env=env,
             stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
        elapsed = time.monotonic()-before
        (work/(label+'.stdout')).write_bytes(process.stdout)
        (work/(label+'.stderr')).write_bytes(process.stderr)
        commands.append({'label':label,'argv':list(map(str,argv)),'cwd':str(work),
             'environment':env,'started_utc':started,'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,
             'returncode':process.returncode,'stdout_bytes':len(process.stdout),
             'stderr_bytes':len(process.stderr)})
        (root/'replay-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands,indent=2)+'\n')
        assert process.returncode == 0 and process.stderr == b'', (label,process.returncode,process.stderr)
        return process
    help_result = run('help',[app,'--help'])
    assert b'--input-script' in help_result.stdout
    actual = run('replay',[app,'--state',state,'--input-script',script,'--diagnostics',diagnostics])
    assert actual.stdout == b''
    data = json.loads(diagnostics.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert data['schema_version'] == 1 and data['controls'] == CONTROLS
    assert data['errors'] == {'count':0,'last':''}
    assert data['runtime']['video_driver'] == 'dummy' and data['runtime']['renderer'] == 'software'
    audio,session,replay = data['audio'],data['session'],data['replay']
    assert audio['driver'] == 'dummy' and audio['sample_rate'] == 48000 and audio['buffer_frames'] == 512
    assert audio['channels'] == 2 and audio['sample_format'] == audio['native_float32_format']
    assert audio['callback_count'] > 0 and audio['rendered_frames'] == audio['callback_count']*512 == session['frame_clock']
    assert all(audio[k] == 0 for k in ('render_failures','format_failures','overrange_failures',
               'overrange_samples','nonfinite_failures','nonfinite_samples'))
    assert session['snapshot_available'] and session['prepared']
    assert not session['running_after_shutdown'] and not session['held_after_shutdown']
    assert all(session[k] == 0 for k in ('fault_flags','queue_overflows','recovery_count','rejected_commands'))
    assert math.isfinite(session['maximum_observed_peak']) and 0 < session['maximum_observed_peak'] <= 1
    assert all(replay[k] for k in ('completed','delivered','passed','final_acknowledged'))
    assert replay['scheduled_events'] == replay['pushed_events'] == 18
    assert replay['accepted_note_on_commands'] == replay['accepted_note_off_commands'] == 4
    assert replay['device_starts'] == 1 and not replay['observations_truncated']
    assert replay['last_submitted_sequence'] == 9
    assert session['discarded_commands'] <= replay['device_starts']
    assert not data['smoke']['requested']
    def held(item):
        return tuple(item['manual_notes'][0]),tuple(item['manual_notes'][1]),tuple(item['pedal_ids'])
    previous = 0
    observed = []
    for item in [*replay['observations'],replay['before_shutdown']]:
        sequence = item['last_applied_sequence']
        assert type(sequence) is int and 1 <= sequence <= 9 and sequence >= previous
        assert item['resolved_sequence'] == sequence
        submitted = item.get('last_submitted_sequence',9)
        assert sequence <= submitted <= 9
        earliest,notes = PREFIXES[sequence-1]
        if 'elapsed_ms' in item:
            assert item['elapsed_ms'] >= earliest
        assert item['controls'] == CONTROLS and held(item) == notes
        observed.append({'sequence':sequence,'holds':held(item)})
        previous = sequence
    assert previous == 9 and held(replay['before_shutdown']) == ((),(),())
    assert state.read_bytes() == STATE and script.read_bytes() == script_bytes
    check_payload()
    result = {'status':'passed','source_commit':commit,'binary_sha256':digest(app.read_bytes()),
        'platform':platform.platform(),'libc':platform.libc_ver(),'python':platform.python_version(),
        'relocated_from':str(original),'relocated_to':str(moved),'original_location_absent':not original.exists(),
        'controls':CONTROLS,'state_sha256':digest(STATE),'script_bytes':len(script_bytes),
        'script_sha256':digest(script_bytes),'diagnostics_sha256':digest(diagnostics.read_bytes()),
        'callbacks':audio['callback_count'],'frames':audio['rendered_frames'],
        'maximum_observed_peak':session['maximum_observed_peak'],
        'note_on':4,'note_off':4,'final_sequence':9,'observed_prefixes':observed,
        'discarded_cleanup_commands':session['discarded_commands'],'commands':commands,
        'scope':'actual downloaded Linux executable, dummy drivers; no physical or other-OS execution'}
    (root/'independent-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','callbacks':result['callbacks'],'frames':result['frames'],
        'observed_sequences':sorted({x['sequence'] for x in observed}),'final_sequence':9}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
